notes.urn:cts:latinLit:tmp1102.tmp1102.opp-lat: 'Lie prostrate' and 'share in the prayer without the offering' are grades of public penance.

nodes.text: XLIV. — 24. Those who seek out divinations and follow the customs of the gentiles, or bring men of this kind into their houses for the purpose of finding something out by magic art, or of purification, shall fall under the canon of five years, according to the fixed grades: three years they shall lie prostrate, two they shall share in the prayer without the offering.
